name: 17 Pro

Network.SIM: Dual eSIM (US, Guam, US Virgin Islands, Canada, Mexico, Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates, Japan), Dual nano-SIM (mainland China), nano-SIM and eSIM (elsewhere)

Body.Other: Emergency SOS, Messages and Find My via satellite, FaceTime audio or video at 1080p over Wi-Fi and 5G, Voice over 5G Standalone (if supported by the carrier)

Memory.Storage: 256 GB, 512 GB, 1 TB, 2 TB (Pro Max only)NVMe

Display.Display: Pro: 6.3 in pixel resolution at 460 ppi, Pro Max: 6.9 in pixel resolution at 460 ppi, ProMotion technology with Variable refresh rate, adaptive refresh rates up to 120 Hz, Always-on display, Always-On display at 1 Hz, Wide color gamut (P3), 2,000,000:1 contrast ratio (typical), 1,000 nits max brightness (typical), 1,600 nits peak brightness (High dynamic range, HDR), 3,000 nits peak brightness (outdoor), 1 nit minimum brightness

Cameras.Rear camera: Fusion Main: 48 MP, 1.78, 24 mm (wide), Fusion Ultrawide: 48 MP, 2.2, 13 mm (ultrawide), Fusion Telephoto: 48 MP, 2.8, 100 mm (periscope telephoto), TOF 3D LiDAR scanner, Dolby Vision, ProRes, ProRes RAW
Cameras.Front camera: 18 MP Center Stage camera, 1.9, 23 mm (wide), Dolby Vision, ProRes, ProRes RAW

Battery.Battery: Pro: 15.534 Wh (3988 mAh) @ 3.895 V (physical SIM), 16.558 Wh (4252 mAh) @ 3.894 V (eSIM), Pro Max: 18.748 Wh (4823 mAh) @ 3.887 V (physical SIM), 19.772 Wh (5088 mAh) @ 3.886 V (eSIM)
Battery.Charging: MagSafe (wireless charger), MagSafe and Qi 2 wireless, USB-C fast-charge, Up to 50% charge in 20 minutes with 40 W adaptor or higher, provided via 15 V

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 7 tri-band, Bluetooth 6.0 (A2DP, LE), Ultra-wideband, Thread, NFC (reader mode, Express Cards), LEO satellite (Globalstar, limited), USB-C: USB 10Gbps, Dual-frequency GPS (L1, L5), GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS, BeiDou, NavIC
